_comment: PRD-270 W2 US-270-11b/c (K8): the item bundle corpus, PRD-261's tests/fixtures/themes/cases.json shape. Python only (the web never validates a bundle): tests/test_prd270w2_bundle_format.py runs every case of the agent and playbook sections (US-270-11b); US-270-11c adds the package and plugin sections and the test that runs them. Each section's base names a valid, canonical fixture beside this file. A case's input is the base with set (each key a dotted path from the document's root, a number naming a list position; a missing last key is added) applied, then unset (dotted paths) removed. A value may be a filler: {"$text": n} is n characters, {"$list": n, "of": v} n copies of v, {"$map": n, "prefix": p, "of": v} an object of n names p0..p(n-1), each v. code is null when the bundle is valid, else the BundleError code validate_bundle raises; with maxBytes, the size check (canonical.capped_bytes) runs after the validator. cap names the schema.py constant a case sits on: every cap of a section's spec has at least one case, and so does every error code. Fake data only: the publisher is 'Test Publisher'.
